g.title: G
g.text: Hardwired VFD Control and Fail-Safe End Stops

g.title: note
g.text: RLY4 uses NO for a fail-safe permissive:
RLY4 ON = TB-1 connected to TB-4 (drive enabled)
RLY4 OFF or loss of HAT power = STOP input opens.
RLY4 NO goes to TB-4 itself, not to DB-0V (TB-2):
TB-1 tied to 0 V would hold the drive stopped.
